## What and why · 改了什么、为什么



## How I verified · 怎么验证的

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (type check, tests and build). · `npm run check` 通过（类型检查、测试和构建）。
- [ ] `desktop.js` and `desktop.css` are rebuilt and committed. · 已重新构建并提交 `desktop.js` 和 `desktop.css`。
- [ ] Tested in Codex Desktop with codexhost ______ (version). · 已在 codexhost ______（版本）的 Codex Desktop 中实测。
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording for visible changes. · 界面有变化时附截图或短录屏。
- [ ] `version` in `manifest.json` is unchanged; it is raised at release. · 未修改 `manifest.json` 的 `version`，发版时统一升级。
